In it, there is a version of Steve Rogers in the same universe as Deadpool.
This does not align with the movie, in which Deadpool travels to the Sacred Timeline in order to fight alongside the Avengers.

It further cannot be the result of Deadpool's time traveling to the main timeline, as one of the interactions with Rogers involves a recreation of the scene from Avengers: Endgame in which Rogers fights his younger self, which cannot have occurred in the main timeline.
Therefore, this comic is considered non-canon.

tags.quote: When the wiki was brought into a transitional period in 2024 as the administration overhaul took place I was allowed a much greater degree of freedom in regard to decisions for the future of the Discussions Area.
My advice has been taken in regard to the promotion of further users into the DA staff team, as well regarding warns and blocks for other users.
I rewrote and reimplemented a new set of Discussion Guidelines.
I proposed the trialling of a new offtopic thread to boost community interaction, which has now gained momentum and continues monthly to great success.

I also advised for the creation of a discord channel within the wiki’s server specifically to deal with DA-related issues, which has allowed for better communication between moderators and admins alike.
I continue to strive for the gradual improvement of the Discussion Area with many plans in the pipeline, and am trusted by admins and other moderators to do so.
Throughout all of my work I have remained a consistent presence within the community am easily accessible via both Discord and my message wall, and users have been able to approach me as necessary.

tags.quote: Shunkō is the highest form of Hakuda techniques.
The technique can manifest itself in various elements such as wind,(Chapter 549) lightning,(Chapter 656) or fire.(Chapter 657)
It is an ultra-powerful technique in which one drives Kidō into one's arms and legs.
The Kidō itself can be controlled and fired at opponents from the body.(Chapter 158)

The Keisen Shōzoku, worn when punishment is carried out, is specifically geared for Shunkō, having no back or sleeves because the fabric will rip apart when the user's back and arms are filled with Kidō, meaning she developed it long before she went into hiding.
Though Yoruichi's Shunkō is perfected, she initially had difficulty controlling it in the fight against Suì-Fēng.
By concentrating Shunkō around a particular area of their body, a practitioner can prevent attacks from damaging or piercing this area.

tags.quote: Mjolnir has also been enchanted so that it will always return to the hand of the person who throws it.

On one occasion, after being thrown while aboard a ship at sea, the hammer tried to return to Thor's grasp but, finding both of its master's hands occupied with holding up the ship's falling smokestack, the hammer settled obediently and within reach on the deck.
Mjolnir and its user share a mystical link that allows the latter to command the hammer.

If the wielder's will is strong enough, the hammer can pass through nearly any barrier to reach them should they so choose; Mjolnir will even carve its way through the very center of entire planets to get back to its master.
